capabilities: Build Activity, Task, and Story hierarchies on a story map
Drag stories into MVP or Later milestone lanes
Link stories to Markdown notes and attach vault or local files
Edit task and activity descriptions with Markdown formatting
Export maps as PNG, PDF, XMind, or JSON
disambiguation: Not a note-relationship mapping tool; it is a product-planning board for user story mapping and release scoping.
extras: Free and open source (MIT) with optional donations that do not unlock features; makes no network requests; legacy .story-map.json and .story-maps/ formats remain supported; simultaneous edits with an agent are not auto-merged, with a backup-and-reload recovery flow.
intentEvidence: Why user story mapping in Obsidian?
motivation: Obsidian puts the plan in the same workspace as requirements, research, and implementation notes, so a file-capable agent can work with the same local files without a separate planning tool.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in visual tool for user story mapping and release planning next to project notes.
summary: User story mapping board that stores maps as local .storymap JSON files for planning activities, tasks, stories, and release milestones.
